# Attempt to fix flaky benchmarks.

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

Related #464 

1. Increases the `margin` for the most moody benchmarks.
2. Attempts to retry the benchmark run before failing the job (caters for the bug in benny, but may also help with results variance).

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Chores**
  * Improved reliability of benchmark workflow by adding automatic retry logic for benchmark runs.
  * Updated benchmark result files to increase or standardize margin of error values and, in some cases, simplify or remove detailed result data.
## Walkthrough

The changes update several benchmark result JSON files to adjust or simplify margin and result reporting, including increasing margin values and removing detailed results or fields. Additionally, the GitHub Actions workflow for benchmarks now uses a retry mechanism to rerun the benchmark command up to three times upon failure.

## Changes

| File(s)                                                                 | Change Summary                                                                                           |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| .github/workflows/benchmarks.yml                                        | Updated benchmark step to use `nick-fields/retry@v3` for up to 3 retries of the benchmark command.       |
| benchmarks/bytes/expected/hex-to.json                                   | Removed detailed benchmark results array; set "results" field to null.                                   |
| benchmarks/codec/expected/view_vs_collection.json                       | Increased margin of error in all benchmarks from 5.0 to 20.0.                                            |
| benchmarks/codec/expected/view_vs_materialized.json                     | Set all margin values to 10 and removed "percentSlower" fields from results.                             |
| benchmarks/collections/expected/map-set.json                            | Increased margin values from 1.0 to 10 for all test cases.                                               |
